Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: In the third step (the final Planner turn), the agent incorrectly deduced the lineage. The WebSurfer results clearly established that Richard Burke, 4th Earl, was the son of Ulick Burke, 3rd Earl, who was the son of Richard Burke, 2nd Earl. The Planner ignored this explicit chain (4th -> 3rd -> 2nd) and erroneously concluded that the father of the 3rd Earl was the 1st Earl (Ulick na gCeann), skipping the 2nd Earl entirely. This led to the wrong identification of the paternal grandfather.
